 ORDER Accused in Spl.C.No.403/2023 pending before the Court of Addl. District & Sessions Judge, FTSC-1,
Hassan arising out of Crime No.113/2023 registered by Belur Police, Hassan District for the offences punishable under Sections 363 & 376 of IPC and and Section 6 of Protection Of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 is before this Court under Section 439 of Cr.P.C,.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent - State.
3. On the complaint of Smt. Eramma W/o late Rudregowda, who is the grandmother of victim girl dated 23.04.2023, FIR in Crime No.113/2023 was registered against unknown person initially for the offence punishable under section 363 of IPC.

sentences.text: During the course of investigation, the petitioner was arrested on 17.06.2023.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.

The petitioner's bail application filed before the trial court in NC: 2023:KHC:33818 Crl.Misc.
No.403/2022 was rejected on 08.08.2023.
Therefore, he is before this Court.

4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition submits that the victim girl has not supported the case of the prosecution during the course of her section 164 of Cr.P.C.,.
He also submits that the petitioner and the victim girl were in love with each other.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned counsel for appearing for defacto complainant does not oppose the bail application.
However, learned HCGP has opposed the bail application.
6. In the complaint it is averred that the complainant's granddaughter aged about 17 years was found missing from the house from 10.03.2023 onwards.

It is in this background, the complainant had approached the police on 23.04.2023 and lodged complaint which had resulted in registering FIR in Crime No.113/2023 against unknown person for the offence punishable under section 363 of IPC.
During the course of investigation, the petitioner and the victim girl were traced on 16.06.2023 and they were brought back.
The petitioner was NC: 2023:KHC:33818 remanded to judicial custody on 17.06.2023.
The statement of the victim girl under section 164 of Cr.P.C., was recorded by the jurisdictional Magistrate on 15.07.2023.
A perusal of the same would go to show that the victim girl has not made any allegation of sexual assault on her by the petitioner.

She has stated that she was in Divakara vs State Of Karnataka By on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138388336/
2 love with the petitioner and she voluntarily accompanied the petitioner and they had stayed together till they were traced and brought back.

sentences.text: The petitioner who is aged about 24 years is in custody since 17.06. 2023.
The investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
Under these circumstances, I am of the view that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively.
7. In view of the above, the petition is allowed.

The petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in Spl.C.No.403/2023 pending before the Court of Addl.
